system.name: Micro Blossom
system.one_liner: a heterogeneous hardware-accelerated Minimum-Weight Perfect Matching decoder achieving sub-microsecond quantum-error-correction decoding

components.name: Controller
components.role: broadcasts instructions to the processing-unit grid and collects the convergecast response

components.name: Quantum Hardware
components.role: 3D grid of parallel processing units performing MWPM decoding directly on syndrome data

components.name: Vertex PU (vPU)
components.role: processing unit dedicated to one vertex of the decoding graph

components.name: Edge PU (ePU)
components.role: processing unit dedicated to one edge of the decoding graph

components.name: Instruction
components.role: broadcast message sent to all processing units

components.name: Local State
components.role: per-PU state updated after receiving an instruction

components.name: Response
components.role: per-PU response generated after updating local state, convergecast into a single response

content.key_idea: Micro Blossom decodes with a 3D grid of one vertex-PU and one edge-PU per decoding-graph vertex/edge, using broadcast instructions and convergecast responses each measurement round to reach sub-microsecond latency.

summary: Micro Blossom is the first publicly known hardware-accelerated exact Minimum-Weight Perfect Matching decoder for quantum error correction, achieving sub-microsecond decoding latency via an FPGA-based heterogeneous architecture. This figure shows the architecture: a host CPU and Controller on the left, connected to a large 3D grid of processing units on the right representing the decoding graph, with one blue Vertex PU (vPU) per vertex and one green Edge PU (ePU) per edge. A small legend illustrates the per-PU cycle of receiving an Instruction, updating Local State, and producing a Response. The main diagram shows the Controller broadcasting an instruction into the grid (fan-out arrows) and collecting a single convergecast response (fan-in arrows), with the grid layers annotated by a time axis (t=1us to t=5us) corresponding to successive syndrome measurement rounds fed in during stream decoding.
summary_zh: 该图展示 Micro Blossom 的异构架构：主机 CPU/控制器向由顶点处理单元（vPU，蓝）和边处理单元（ePU，绿）组成的三维网格广播指令，各单元更新本地状态后再汇聚为单一响应，网格按测量轮次时间轴排列。
